586-678-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
586-678-7272.description:
Cast Priest of Gix by paying its mana cost.
When Priest of Gix enters, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

628-1872-2018.description:
Activate Composite Golem by sacrificing it.
When Composite Golem dies, Mikaeus triggers, returning Composite Golem from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Composite Golem by sacrificing it.
When Composite Golem dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Composite Golem from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Repeat

1052-3175-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2511-3025.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Bastion of Remembrance and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1170-5131-5315-7693--202.easyPrerequisites:
Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-5315-7693--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Armor Wars.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing the artifact, giving Ravenous Intruder +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.

225-1308-3129-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

275-1594-5078.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Helm of Awakening.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Transplant Theorist triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Transplant Theorist trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

2685-4017-4186-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2685-4017-4186-7810.description:
Gain life.
Sunbond triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

2279-2921-3240-6462.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Quintorius triggers, creating a Treasure token and creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2034-4871-6201-7147-7654.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Sundering Archaic by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Sunscape Familiar.
Repeat.

413-3175-7424.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

3398-7025-7121.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Hellkite Charger
3398-7025-7121.description:
Activate Fire Nation Palace by paying {1}{R} and tapping it, giving Hellkite Charger firebending 4 until end of turn.
Declare Hellkite Charger as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, its regular ability and Avatar Roku.
Resolve the Avatar Roku and firebending triggers, adding ten {R}.
Resolve the second Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

206-392-3292-3892.description:
Cast Spear Spewer by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Activate Spear Spewer by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each player.
Dissipation Field triggers, returning Spear Spewer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
206-392-3292-3892.notes: It is recommended to perform this combo when you have more life than your opponents to end the game, but it is not required. If this combo will not end the game, stop once you have 1 life.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-6633-7357.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6633-7357.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Pugnacious Pugilist as attackers.
Pugnacious Pugilist triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
If the sacrificed creature was a Devil token, it triggers when it dies, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat each combat phase.

539-2244-4803-7175.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {W}.
539-2244-4803-7175.description:
Activate a permanent by tapping it, adding at least {W}.
Activate Nimbleclaw Adept by tapping it, untapping Ruin Ghost and the permanent.
Activate Ruin Ghost by paying {W} and tapping it, blinking Nimbleclaw Adept.
Repeat.

1453-2387-3490-4927.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
1453-2387-3490-4927.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to Arwen's toughness.
Animation Module triggers. Holding priority, activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to Arwen's toughness.
Repeat from step 3.

1636-4023-5147-6987.notablePrerequisites: Need to have a total of 5 artifact creatures
1636-4023-5147-6987.description:
Cast Robobrain War Mind by paying {3}{U}.
When Robobrain War Mind enters, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Robobrain War Mind trigger, causing you to get {E} for each artifact creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Robobrain War Mind.
Activate Dr. Madison Li by tapping it and paying {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}, returning Robobrain War Mind from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1651-2499-3875-4935-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-2499-3875-4935-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-2499-3875-4935-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers twice due to Yarok, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

527-1978-5143.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
527-1978-5143.description:
Cause Selvala to become an artifact using Transmogrifying Licid.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Selvala.
Repeat from step 2.

813-2417-4377.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Walk the Aeons and Siren's Ruse.
813-2417-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Siren's Ruse by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons and Siren's Ruse from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

2793-5089-5666-5668-6320.description:
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Saheeli's first ability triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Saheeli's second ability triggers, causing you to pay {E}{E}{E} to create a token copy of Ugin's Nexus that is a 5/5 artifact creature.
Put the nontoken Ugin's Nexus into exile due to the legend rule and its replacement effect, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it.
At the beginning of the end step, Saheeli triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Ugin's Nexus token. The token put into exile due to its replacement effect, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your first extra turn.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, putting Ugin's Nexus into your hand from exile.
Move to your second extra turn, and repeat from step 1.

1371-3432-5426-6500.easyPrerequisites:
There is a land on the battlefield.
Each opponent has 40 or less life.
1371-3432-5426-6500.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Tephraderm indestructible
1371-3432-5426-6500.description:
Give Tephraderm indestructible, if needed.
Cast Insult by paying {2}{R}, doubling the damage sources you control deal this turn.
Cast Star of Extinction by paying {5}{R}{R}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to copy Star of Extinction.
Resolve an opponent's Star of Extinction, destroying a land and dealing 20 damage to each creature and planeswalker.
Tephraderm's second ability triggers, dealing 40 damage to the opponent who controlled the Star of Extinction copy due to Insult.
Repeat from step 5 for each remaining Star of Extinction until each opponent loses the game.
1371-3432-5426-6500.notes: If an opponent survives the loop, you will lose the game if you have 80 or less life once your own Star of Extinction resolves.

2034-4484-4871-6277.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
2034-4484-4871-6277.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ebondeath, adding {C}{C}.
When Ebondeath dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {2}{B}{B}.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1563-2351-4359-6460.easyPrerequisites:
You control a token.
It is an opponent's turn.
1563-2351-4359-6460.description:
Activate Hardened Tactician by paying {1} and sacrificing a token.
If you sacrificed a Tentacle, The Watcher's second ability triggers if the creature token was a Tentacle, untapping a Kraken and putting a stun counter on up to one nonland permanent.
Resolve the Hardened Tactician ability, causing you to draw a card.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate the Tentacle by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

3204-4251-4885-6188.notablePrerequisites:
Fear of Missing Out cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Fear of Missing Out or Godo must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
3204-4251-4885-6188.description:
Declare either Fear of Missing Out or Godo and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Fear of Missing Out or Godo trigger.
Resolve the Fear of Missing Out or Godo trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Fear of Missing Out or Godo from the battlefield, and then returning Fear of Missing Out or Godo from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

2034-2523-5558.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Enraged Huorn, adding {C}{C}.
When Enraged Huorn dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Enraged Huorn that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Enraged Huorn token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Enraged Huorn token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Repeat.

719-1486-1753-2872.notablePrerequisites: Xenograft on the battlefield with "Dwarf" chosen.
719-1486-1753-2872.description:
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Clever Conjurer ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, targeting Clever Conjurer.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Samut trigger, untapping Clever Conjurer.
Repeat.
719-1486-1753-2872.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

56-789-4556-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-789-4556-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Blight Mound and Gutter Grime trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Repeat.
56-789-4556-5256.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

862-5852-5929.description:
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}, and choosing to pay its replicate cost an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}.
Crimson Kobolds triggers, creating a copy of it for each time its replicate cost was paid.
Resolve all Crimson Kobolds spells, causing the nontoken Crimson Kobolds to enter the battlefield, and creating a token copy of it for each time its replicate cost was paid.

3487-4374-5334.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two energy counters.
3487-4374-5334.description:
Activate Aethergeode Miner by paying {E}{E}, blinking it.
When Aethergeode Miner enters the battlefield, Aetherstorm Roc triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Repeat.

3693-4282-4613.notablePrerequisites:
Garza Zol has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You have a way to give Garza Zol deathtouch.
3693-4282-4613.description:
Give Garza Zol deathtouch, if needed.
Activate Garza Zol using Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to a creature an opponent controls.
The creature dies as a state-based action due to Garza Zol's deathtouch.
Garza Zol's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat from step 2.
You may also repeat this combo whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control if you can give Garza Zol deathtouch indefinitely.

1558-2397-2963-4840.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Myr Battlesphere.
When Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers twice, creating eight 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Myrs, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

539-3812-4878.notablePrerequisites:
Market Festival attached to Simic Ragworm.
Simic Ragworm does not have summoning sickness.
539-3812-4878.description:
Activate Simic Ragworm by tapping it, adding {G}.
Market Festival triggers, adding {U} and one mana of any color.
Activate Simic Ragworm by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat

1409-2366-2653-4482.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Dryad Arbor.
1409-2366-2653-4482.description:
Activate Dryad Arbor by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Dryad Arbor enters the battlefield, triggering Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability and Nissa twice.
Resolve both Nissa triggers, adding {1}{U}.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Dryad Arbor.
Repeat.

215-3771-4050-5031.notablePrerequisites: Skitterbeam Batallion in hand.Animar has at least nine +1/+1 counters on it.
215-3771-4050-5031.description:
Cast Skitterbeam Batallion by paying {0}.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Skitterbeam Batallion enters the battlefield, creating two token copies of it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the two Skitterbeam Batallion tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Skitterbeam Batallion from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

512-3576-4832.notablePrerequisites:
Ensoul Artifact attached to Halo Fountain.
Vedalken Engineer and Halo Fountain do not have summoning sickness.
512-3576-4832.description:
Activate Vedalken Engineer by tapping it, adding {W}{W} that can only be spent to cast artifact spells or activate abilities of artifacts.
Activate Halo Fountain's second ability by paying {W}{W}, tapping it and untapping Halo Fountain and Vedalken Engineer, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

3334-3484-4374.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two energy counters.
3334-3484-4374.description:
Activate Aethergeode Miner by paying {E}{E}, blinking it.
Aethergeode Miner enters the battlefield, triggering Decoction Module, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Paradox Haze.

722-736-1949.notablePrerequisites: Paradox Haze and Copy Enchantment attached to you.
722-736-1949.description:
Cast Chronomantic Escape by paying {4}{W}{W}, causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and exiling Chronomantic Escape with three time counters on it.
During the first upkeep step of your next turn, Paradox Haze and Copy Enchantment each trigger, causing you to get two additional upkeep steps.
Move through your first and second upkeep steps, removing two time counters from Chronomantic Escape.
Move through your final upkeep step, removing the final time counter from Chronomantic Escape and causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Chronomantic Escape, causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and exiling Chronomantic Escape with three time counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

404-1521-1753-2105.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
404-1521-1753-2105.description:
Declare Flamerush Rider, Combat Celebrant and Ghired as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant, Ghired's second ability and Flamerush Rider trigger.
Resolve the Flamerush Rider trigger, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant that is tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Ghired trigger, creating a copy of the Combat Celebrant token.
Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase, and declare the Combat Celebrant token created in step 4 and Ghired as attackers, choosing to exert the Combat Celebrant token as it attacks.
Repeat from step 4.
Optionally, you may also attack with Flamerush Rider to get infinite copies of any other attacking creatures you control.

1409-1971-2060.notablePrerequisites:
Yannik is paired with Deadeye Navigator.
You control another creature with base power 2 or greater.
1409-1971-2060.description:
Activate Yannik by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Yannik leaves the battlefield, returning any card exiled with it to the battlefield under your control.
When Yannik enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers.
Resolve the Yannik trigger, exiling another creature with base power 2 or greater and putting at least two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Yannik.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.
If the exiled creature has base power 3 or greater, this combo nets infinite mana and +1/+1 counters.

1657-2376-4050.description:
Sacrifice Murderous Redcap to Phyrexian Altar adding 1 mana of any color to your mana pool.
Return Redcap to battlefield using persist dealing 2 damage to any target, giving a +1/+1 counter from Rhythm of the Wild removing the -1/-1 counter.
Repeat.

411-2520-3168.description:
Activate Grinning Ignus by paying {R} and returning it to your hand, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Cast Grinning Ignus by paying {R}.
Activate Skyshroud Elf by paying {1}, adding {R}.
Repeat.
